name: Rikumori Yuu
source:
"Give me more praise."

The student council secretary. Contrary to his rugged and macho appearance, he is humble and a bit of an airhead. He's ambitious and full of curiosity. He speaks clearly and frankly to everyone in a mature manner.

He is good at dealing with Rin. He listens to Sakuya's lectures with a smile on his face. He only called Arata "Chuuniboyu" for a while.

Sign: Libra
Likes: Beautiful things, shoujo manga, Japanese sweets
Dislikes: Being ostracized
Power: Earth

[Translated from [url=http://dearmagi.caerux.com/character/]official website[/url]]
